literal: hand in hand · side by side · shoulder
natural: hand in hand and shoulder to shoulder

meaning.en: To work together closely and support each other, as allies.
meaning.zh: 紧密合作、互相支持，像盟友一样并肩作战。

examples.zh: 两国携手并肩，共同应对灾害。
examples.en: The two countries joined hands to deal with the disaster together.

examples.zh: 同学们携手并肩，走过了高三。
examples.en: The classmates stood together through their final school year.

examples.zh: 我们要携手并肩，把项目做好。
examples.en: We should work shoulder to shoulder to make the project a success.

usage.en: Positive; formal to neutral. More emotional than 携手合作. Used in speeches, news and thank-you messages.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式到中性。比“携手合作”更有感情色彩，用于讲话、新闻和感谢辞。

meaning.en: To progress together by working side by side.
meaning.zh: 携起手来，一同前进。

examples.zh: 愿我们携手共进，共创美好未来。
examples.en: May we advance together and build a good future.

examples.zh: 两所学校携手共进，共享教学资源。
examples.en: The two schools advance together and share teaching resources.

examples.zh: 他们携手共进，一起走过了二十年。
examples.en: They have moved forward together for twenty years.

usage.en: Positive; formal; typical of speeches, greeting cards and news. The variant 携手同行 (walk together hand in hand) is slightly more personal.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式；常见于讲话、贺卡和新闻。变体“携手同行”稍带个人情感。

meaning.en: To build or create something together through joint effort.
meaning.zh: 共同努力，一起创造或建设。

examples.zh: 让我们携手共创美好明天。
examples.en: Let us build a better tomorrow together.

examples.zh: 论坛的主题是携手共创绿色未来。
examples.en: The theme of the forum is building a green future together.

examples.zh: 两位设计师携手共创了这个品牌。
examples.en: The two designers created the brand together.

usage.en: Positive; formal. Needs an object saying what is created (未来, 辉煌, 价值). Typical of slogans, forum titles and business speeches.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式。后面须有宾语说明创造什么（未来、辉煌、价值）。常见于口号、论坛主题和商务讲话。

meaning.en: To get through a difficult period or crisis by working together.
meaning.zh: 大家一起努力，渡过艰难的时期。

examples.zh: 面对危机，各方应该共克时艰。
examples.en: Facing the crisis, all parties should pull together through the hard times.

examples.zh: 全体员工愿与公司共克时艰。
examples.en: All staff are willing to get through the hard times with the company.

examples.zh: 邻里互相帮助，共克时艰。
examples.en: Neighbours helped each other to get through the hard times.

usage.en: Formal; positive. Very common in news and official statements about crises, epidemics and economic downturns. 克 means 'overcome' and 时艰 'the hardship of the times'.
usage.zh: 正式，褒义。新闻和官方声明中谈危机、疫情和经济下行时很常见。“克”是战胜，“时艰”指时局艰难。

natural: get through a difficult time together

meaning.en: To pull through a difficult situation together.
meaning.zh: 共同度过艰难的处境。

examples.zh: 全家人齐心协力，共渡难关。
examples.en: The whole family pulled together to get through the hard time.

examples.zh: 工厂和工人约定共渡难关。
examples.en: The factory and its workers agreed to get through the difficulty together.

examples.zh: 朋友们帮他共渡难关。
examples.en: His friends helped him pull through.

usage.en: Positive; neutral to formal. Slightly more everyday than 共克时艰. Often follows 携手 or 齐心协力. Both 渡 and 度 are seen, but 渡 is standard in this phrase.
usage.zh: 褒义，中性到正式。比“共克时艰”稍口语化。常接在“携手”“齐心协力”之后。“渡”“度”都有人写，此处以“渡”为标准写法。

meaning.en: To take action against an epidemic, such as treatment, prevention and control.
meaning.zh: 对疫情采取行动，包括救治和防控。

examples.zh: 医护人员奋战在抗击疫情的第一线。
examples.en: Medical staff worked on the front line of the fight against the epidemic.

examples.zh: 许多志愿者参与了社区的抗击疫情工作。
examples.en: Many volunteers took part in the community's anti-epidemic work.

examples.zh: 各国需要合作抗击疫情。
examples.en: Countries need to cooperate to fight the epidemic.

usage.en: Neutral and factual; formal. Used in news and official reports, especially since 2020 for the COVID-19 response. Often attributive, e.g. 抗击疫情的成果.
usage.zh: 中性，客观，正式。用于新闻和官方报告，2020年以来尤其指应对新冠疫情。常作定语，如“抗击疫情的成果”。

meaning.en: The measures taken to prevent and contain the spread of an epidemic.
meaning.zh: 预防和控制疫情蔓延所采取的措施。

examples.zh: 学校严格落实疫情防控要求。
examples.en: The school strictly follows the epidemic prevention and control requirements.

examples.zh: 进入小区需要配合疫情防控检查。
examples.en: To enter the housing compound you must cooperate with the epidemic control checks.

examples.zh: 疫情防控取得了阶段性成效。
examples.en: Epidemic prevention and control achieved results at this stage.

usage.en: Neutral and factual; formal administrative term, common in notices and news since 2020. Usually a noun, often with 工作 or 措施.
usage.zh: 中性，客观，正式的行政用语，2020年以来常见于通知和新闻。多作名词，常接“工作”“措施”。

meaning.en: Cooperation between regions or departments to prevent and control a problem together, especially an epidemic.
meaning.zh: 地区或部门之间协作，共同预防和控制某一问题，尤指疫情。

examples.zh: 各部门建立了联防联控机制。
examples.en: The departments set up a joint prevention and control mechanism.

examples.zh: 两市联防联控，降低了传播风险。
examples.en: The two cities coordinated prevention and control and lowered the risk of spread.

examples.zh: 社区、医院和学校联防联控。
examples.en: The community, hospitals and schools worked together on prevention and control.

usage.en: Neutral; formal administrative term, strongly linked to 联防联控机制 in the 2020 epidemic response. Also used for air pollution and security work.
usage.zh: 中性，正式的行政用语，与2020年疫情应对中的“联防联控机制”联系紧密。也用于大气污染治理和治安工作。

meaning.en: An approach in which ordinary residents take part in preventing and dealing with problems such as crime, disease or disasters.
meaning.zh: 由普通群众参与预防和处理犯罪、疾病、灾害等问题的做法。

examples.zh: 社区推行群防群治，减少了盗窃案件。
examples.en: The neighbourhood has promoted community-wide prevention and reduced theft.

examples.zh: 疫情期间，群防群治发挥了作用。
examples.en: During the epidemic, community-wide prevention and control played a part.

examples.zh: 村里组织巡逻队，搞群防群治。
examples.en: The village organised patrol teams to involve everyone in prevention.

usage.en: Neutral; formal; official term from the 'mass line' tradition. Common in community, public-security and epidemic notices; often paired with 联防联控.
usage.zh: 中性，正式，源于“群众路线”传统的官方用语。常见于社区、治安和疫情通知，常与“联防联控”并用。

meaning.en: To deal with each other openly and honestly, without hiding anything.
meaning.zh: 彼此坦率真诚，毫无保留。

examples.zh: 两位老朋友坦诚相见，把误会说开了。
examples.en: The two old friends were frank with each other and cleared up the misunderstanding.

examples.zh: 谈判双方坦诚相见，气氛融洽。
examples.en: The two sides in the talks were open with each other and the mood was warm.

examples.zh: 夫妻之间应该坦诚相见。
examples.en: Husband and wife should be open with each other.

usage.en: Positive; neutral. Used of friends, couples, negotiators and colleagues. Not to be taken literally as 'meeting naked', although the words can be played on in jokes.
usage.zh: 褒义，中性。用于朋友、夫妻、谈判双方和同事之间。不要按字面理解成“裸身相见”，不过有时被人拿来开玩笑。

meaning.en: To work together wholeheartedly and in good faith.
meaning.zh: 真心实意、全心全意地合作。

examples.zh: 两家单位精诚合作，提前完成了任务。
examples.en: The two units cooperated wholeheartedly and finished ahead of schedule.

examples.zh: 只有精诚合作，才能成功。
examples.en: Only wholehearted cooperation can lead to success.

examples.zh: 双方签约，约定精诚合作。
examples.en: Both sides signed and agreed to cooperate in good faith.

usage.en: Positive; formal. Common in contracts, speeches and thank-you messages. 精诚 (utter sincerity) is a classical word, as in 精诚所至，金石为开.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式。常见于合同、讲话和感谢辞。“精诚”是古语，如“精诚所至，金石为开”。

meaning.en: To be united and act with one purpose.
meaning.zh: 团结起来，行动一致。

examples.zh: 全班团结一心，赢得了合唱比赛。
examples.en: The whole class stood united and won the choir competition.

examples.zh: 只要团结一心，没有克服不了的困难。
examples.en: As long as we are united, no difficulty is insurmountable.

examples.zh: 公司上下团结一心，渡过了难关。
examples.en: The company pulled together as one and got through the hard time.

usage.en: Positive; neutral. A modern four-character set phrase, close to 同心同德 and 万众一心, used in speeches, school and sports commentary.
usage.zh: 褒义，中性。现代的四字固定词组，与“同心同德”“万众一心”相近，用于讲话、学校和体育评论。

meaning.en: To unite and work hard together towards a goal.
meaning.zh: 团结一致，共同努力实现目标。

examples.zh: 全国人民团结奋斗，取得了脱贫攻坚的胜利。
examples.en: The whole nation strove together and won the fight against poverty.

examples.zh: 我们要团结奋斗，把工厂办好。
examples.en: We must strive in unity to run the factory well.

examples.zh: 团结奋斗是校训的一部分。
examples.en: 'Strive in unity' is part of the school motto.

usage.en: Positive; formal; typical of slogans, mottos and speeches. Often written together as 团结奋斗、开拓进取.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式；常见于口号、校训和讲话，常与“开拓进取”并列。

meaning.en: To stay united and coordinate with each other in work.
meaning.zh: 团结一致，互相配合工作。

examples.zh: 项目成功靠的是大家团结协作。
examples.en: The project succeeded thanks to everyone's teamwork.

examples.zh: 这个班级团结协作，从不内耗。
examples.en: This class works together without infighting.

examples.zh: 评语写着：团结协作，乐于助人。
examples.en: The comment reads: works well with others and is happy to help.

usage.en: Positive; formal; common in school report comments, appraisals and job descriptions.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式；常见于学校评语、考核和招聘要求。

meaning.en: The willingness to put the group's goals first and work well with others.
meaning.zh: 把集体目标放在首位、善于与人合作的意识。

examples.zh: 招聘启事要求应聘者有团队精神。
examples.en: The job advertisement asks candidates to have team spirit.

examples.zh: 足球不仅靠技术，更靠团队精神。
examples.en: Football depends not just on skill but on team spirit.

examples.zh: 他缺少团队精神，总想自己出风头。
examples.en: He lacks team spirit and always wants to hog the limelight.

usage.en: Neutral; a modern word group, a translation of English 'team spirit'. Common in job ads, sports and business.
usage.zh: 中性；现代词组，对应英文 team spirit。常见于招聘、体育和商务。

meaning.en: Working together as a group to reach a shared goal.
meaning.zh: 集体协作，共同完成目标。

examples.zh: 这个项目需要很强的团队合作。
examples.en: This project calls for strong teamwork.

examples.zh: 学校通过游戏培养学生的团队合作能力。
examples.en: The school develops pupils' teamwork skills through games.

examples.zh: 出色的团队合作让球队拿到了冠军。
examples.en: Excellent teamwork won the team the title.

usage.en: Neutral; a modern word group that is common everywhere from schools to offices. Often used with 能力 or 意识.
usage.zh: 中性；现代词组，从学校到办公室都常用。常与“能力”“意识”搭配。

meaning.en: To work together with others on the same job or project.
meaning.zh: 与他人一起做同一项工作或项目。

examples.zh: 我们合作共事多年，彼此很熟悉。
examples.en: We have worked together for many years and know each other well.

examples.zh: 与不同背景的人合作共事，能学到很多。
examples.en: You learn a lot from working with people of different backgrounds.

examples.zh: 这两位导演第一次合作共事。
examples.en: This is the first time the two directors have worked together.

usage.en: Neutral; fairly formal. Describes the fact of working together, without strong praise. Often follows 一起 or 多年.
usage.zh: 中性，较正式。陈述共同工作这一事实，没有强烈褒扬。常接在“一起”“多年”之后。

meaning.en: The shared use of materials, data, facilities or information by several parties.
meaning.zh: 多方共同使用物资、数据、设施或信息。

examples.zh: 几所学校实现了图书馆资源共享。
examples.en: Several schools now share library resources.

examples.zh: 企业之间资源共享，可以降低成本。
examples.en: Resource sharing between firms can lower costs.

examples.zh: 网络让知识资源共享成为可能。
examples.en: The internet makes it possible to share knowledge resources.

usage.en: Neutral; formal; common in education, business and technology writing. Often paired with 优势互补.
usage.zh: 中性，正式；常见于教育、商业和科技类文章，常与“优势互补”并用。

meaning.en: To combine different strengths so that each makes up for the other's weaknesses.
meaning.zh: 把各自不同的长处结合起来，互相弥补不足。

examples.zh: 两家公司优势互补，合作很顺利。
examples.en: The two companies complement each other's strengths and cooperate smoothly.

examples.zh: 他们俩性格不同，却能优势互补。
examples.en: They have different personalities but make a complementary pair.

examples.zh: 组队时要注意优势互补。
examples.en: When forming a team, pay attention to complementary strengths.

usage.en: Positive; formal to neutral. Common in business, team-building and school group-work contexts. Often followed by 互利共赢.
usage.zh: 褒义，正式到中性。常见于商业、团队建设和学校小组活动，后面常接“互利共赢”。

natural: each takes what they do best

meaning.en: For each party to use its own strengths in a joint effort.
meaning.zh: 各方发挥自己的长处，合力做事。

equivalents: each contributes what they do best

examples.zh: 团队里大家各取所长，分工明确。
examples.en: In the team everyone plays to their strengths, with clear division of work.

examples.zh: 几位老师各取所长，合编了一本教材。
examples.en: Several teachers each contributed their strengths to compile a textbook.

examples.zh: 我们各取所长，我负责设计，他负责销售。
examples.en: We each play to our strengths: I handle design and he handles sales.

usage.en: Positive; neutral. Not to be confused with 各取所需 (each takes what he needs). Here 长 is cháng, meaning 'strength'.
usage.zh: 褒义，中性。注意与“各取所需”（各自拿自己需要的）区别。这里“长”读 cháng，指长处。

meaning.en: To give guidance suited to each type of case or group, rather than one approach for all.
meaning.zh: 根据不同类型或群体的特点，分别给予有针对性的指导。

examples.zh: 教育部门要求对不同学校分类指导。
examples.en: The education authorities require guidance tailored to different types of school.

examples.zh: 扶贫工作要做到分类指导、精准施策。
examples.en: Poverty-relief work should offer tailored guidance and targeted measures.

examples.zh: 老师根据学生基础分类指导。
examples.en: The teacher gives guidance by group according to the pupils' level.

usage.en: Neutral; formal administrative term, used in education and policy documents. Often paired with 因材施教 in education, and 精准施策 in policy.
usage.zh: 中性，正式的行政用语，用于教育和政策文件。教育中常与“因材施教”并用，政策中常与“精准施策”并用。

meaning.en: A teaching method that groups pupils by level or ability and teaches each group accordingly.
meaning.zh: 按学生水平或能力分组，分别开展教学的方法。

examples.zh: 英语课采用分层教学，基础不同的学生分在不同班。
examples.en: The English class uses tiered teaching, placing pupils of different levels in different groups.

examples.zh: 分层教学可以照顾每个孩子的进度。
examples.en: Tiered teaching can suit each child's pace.

examples.zh: 家长对分层教学有不同看法。
examples.en: Parents have different views on tiered teaching.

usage.en: Neutral; educational term, used in school management and teacher training. Debates exist about fairness, so tone should stay factual.
usage.zh: 中性，教育术语，用于学校管理和教师培训。对其公平性有不同看法，表述宜客观。

meaning.en: Education that aims at overall development, including moral, intellectual, physical and artistic qualities, not just exam scores.
meaning.zh: 着眼于学生全面发展，包括品德、智力、体质和艺术素养，而不只看考试成绩的教育。

examples.zh: 学校推行素质教育，开设了许多兴趣课程。
examples.en: The school promotes quality-oriented education and offers many interest courses.

examples.zh: 素质教育和应试教育常被拿来比较。
examples.en: Quality-oriented education is often compared with exam-oriented education.

examples.zh: 家长希望孩子接受素质教育。
examples.en: Parents want their children to have a well-rounded education.

usage.en: Neutral; official education term since the 1990s, often contrasted with 应试教育 (exam-oriented education). Also used loosely for extracurricular lessons.
usage.zh: 中性，1990年代以来的官方教育术语，常与“应试教育”对举。口语中也泛指课外兴趣班。

meaning.en: The idea of continuing to learn throughout life, not only in school.
meaning.zh: 一生都不断学习，而不限于在校期间的理念。

examples.zh: 在快速变化的时代，终身学习变得越来越重要。
examples.en: In a fast-changing age, lifelong learning grows ever more important.

examples.zh: 他六十岁开始学钢琴，是终身学习的榜样。
examples.en: He began learning the piano at sixty, a model of lifelong learning.

examples.zh: 图书馆倡导终身学习。
examples.en: The library promotes lifelong learning.

usage.en: Positive; neutral to formal. Translation of 'lifelong learning'; echoes the old saying 活到老，学到老. Common in education policy and self-improvement.
usage.zh: 褒义，中性到正式。对应 lifelong learning，与俗语“活到老，学到老”相呼应。常见于教育政策和自我提升。
